Green's work is primarily in film production and motion graphics, which may include some animation elements but does not make her principally an animator. This flawed instruction set led WebSurfer to retrieve information focused on keyword counts rather than qualitative context, ultimately delaying the resolution of the task and creating confusion in assessing the two candidates.  

This error falls under the pattern of "Overgeneralization of Partial Information," similar to Example 2. It predominantly originates from misaligned priorities in the Planner's decision-making process and an ineffective heuristic for determining "known for animation."
